training.population: fixed species x 99 pilot island targets with unknown cells excluded
training.target: binary certain presence versus checklist absence

source_feature_rules.pilot_target: remove the entire target pilot archipelago's occurrence information from the source set before computing every species-conditioned feature
source_feature_rules.confirmatory_target: source set is the complete frozen 99-island pilot response only; no confirmatory occurrence may enter any feature
source_feature_rules.regional_no_training_support: use smoothed global prevalence and regional_pool_training_support=0
source_feature_rules.h_E: 0x1.5240c887808e0p+7 km; exact median of all 3369 frozen v1.47 generic graph edge lengths
source_feature_rules.graph_source_set: certain-presence source islands in the target 60-degree regional pool only
source_feature_rules.graph_paths: shortest weighted paths on the frozen v1.47 response-independent graph; other islands in the target heldout archipelago are removed as intermediate nodes
source_feature_rules.graph_no_occupied_source: pressure=0 and nearest distance set to 1.05 times the response-independent graph diameter of that regional pool; R3 regional prevalence remains the information about local source absence
source_feature_rules.source_features_restandardized: fit means/SDs using pilot training feature rows only, freeze them, and apply unchanged to confirmatory rows

before_confirmatory_response: all 404 x fixed-species confirmatory probabilities under R3 and C
eligible confirmatory target mask independent of confirmatory outcomes

primary.estimand: equal-weight mean across 59 confirmatory archipelagos of within-archipelago mean(loss_C-loss_R3)
primary.support_rule: point estimate <0 and deterministic 95% bootstrap upper bound <0
